title: Thermal Advisory: Afternoon Peak
body: A hot front hits this afternoon: ambient +12 °C at peak, with the AC-1 racks at full load. Rented chillers cut the spike to +5 °C for $60k. A second air handler would cut it for good.

choices.label: Ride it out
choices.outcome: Peak ambient reached +12°C. The racks coped, mostly.

choices.label: Rent chillers
choices.outcome: Portable chillers arrived at noon and left at six.

title: Weather Advisory: Heatwave
body: Ambient runs 9 °C above seasonal for a day, and every cooler loses efficiency with it. Chillers for $90k hold the rise to 4 °C. Without them, expect throttled racks.

votes.line: Chillers. A 5 °C difference is a day of full-speed racks.
The extra chiller load is power we do not have spare.
Throttled racks are lost output. I would pay.

choices.label: Rent chillers
choices.outcome: Temporary chillers took the edge off the peak.

choices.label: Ride it out
choices.outcome: The racks throttled and the day passed.

title: Grid Notice: Scheduled Brownout
body: The utility halves our grid import for 8 hours. Storage for $100k limits the cut to 20%. Auto load-shed takes the full 50% and sheds racks until demand fits.

votes.line: Shed racks stop making heat too. I can live with either.
Storage.
A shed rack is an idle rack. Buy the storage.

choices.label: Buy storage
choices.hint: -$100k now · grid import x0.8 for 8h · Garden +3
choices.outcome: Rented battery containers covered most of the shortfall.

choices.label: Auto load-shed
choices.outcome: The scheduler shed low-priority jobs and the queue backed up.

title: Market Notice: Energy Price Spike
body: Spot power runs well above contract tomorrow. A solar PPA costs $120k and holds the rise to 10%. Shifting load costs $40k and the price still rises 30% for the day.

votes.line: Shifting load also lets the plant rest overnight.
A PPA is a 10% rise instead of 30%. That is the better price.
I can run training at night. Shift it.

choices.label: Sign solar PPA
choices.hint: -$120k now · energy price x1.1 for 1d · Garden +5
choices.outcome: The agreement caps tomorrow's exposure and starts a longer relationship.

choices.label: Shift load
choices.hint: -$40k now · energy price x1.3 for 1d · Lattice +3
choices.outcome: The scheduler moved jobs to cheaper hours. Throughput suffered.

title: Weather Advisory: Dunkelflaute
body: Two days of low sun and still air. Panel and mast output will approach zero. Storage costs $150k and holds the price rise to 15%. Gensets cost nothing now, but power runs 50% dearer for 2 days.

votes.line: Gensets run hot. Storage is quieter.
Storage. I do not trust a fuel line in winter.
Gensets keep every rack running. Output over principle.

choices.label: Buy storage
choices.hint: -$150k now · energy price x1.15 for 2d · Garden +4
choices.outcome: Contracted storage covered the worst of it.

choices.label: Run gensets
choices.outcome: The gensets ran for two days. The fuel invoice followed.

title: Facility Inspection
body: An inspector arrives this week and wants cooling, power and job logs. Cooperating costs $120k. Stalling costs $30k, and new contract payouts drop 15% for 3 days.

choices.label: Cooperate
choices.outcome: The inspector found nothing, then billed you for the visit.

choices.label: Stall
choices.hint: -$30k now · new contract payouts x0.85 for 3d
choices.outcome: The inspection was rescheduled. Goodwill was not.

title: Levy Notice: Energy Surcharge
body: A surcharge on energy use starts this quarter. Paying costs $150k. Offsets cost $90k and count toward the Garden. Cheaper and greener. I'd call that an easy one.

choices.label: Pay levy
choices.outcome: The levy was paid in full.

choices.label: Buy offsets
choices.outcome: Offset certificates were accepted at a discount.

title: Notice: Domestic Compute Subsidy
body: The Authority offers a $200k subsidy for national programmes. It comes with reporting duties and a say in what you build.

votes.line: More reports are more paperwork. Not my problem.
Cash is cash. Take it.
Reporting means someone reads my numbers. Acceptable.

choices.label: Claim subsidy
choices.outcome: The subsidy arrived. So did the reporting template.

choices.label: Decline
choices.outcome: The offer was withdrawn with no comment.

title: Authority Research Grant
body: The Authority funds one partnership: a wet lab or an AI lab. Either pays $200k. The wet lab pushes you toward the organoids, the AI lab towards silicon.

votes.line: A wet lab needs its own cooling loop. Take the AI lab.
Tissue is low power. But so are the people who sign for it.
The substrate is eager. Lease the wet lab.

choices.label: Lease wet lab
choices.outcome: The lab moved in on Monday. Its freezers arrived on Tuesday.

choices.label: Host AI lab
choices.outcome: The lab brought its own models and a long list of requirements.

title: Wetware Pilot Programme
body: The Authority pilots tissue-based computing. Joining costs $60k and moves you 4 points toward the Flesh. The brochure says low-power eleven times. It is correct about that.

choices.label: Join pilot
choices.outcome: You enrolled. The pilot coordinator sent a gift basket of reagents.

choices.label: Decline
choices.outcome: You declined. The brochure was recycled.

title: Tariff Notice: Heat Export Revision
body: The district heat network pays more for exported heat but wants a longer term. Signing pays $140k now and adds 5% to energy prices for 3 days while the meters change. Keeping the old terms changes nothing.

votes.line: Heat we export is heat I do not cool.
Longer terms mean a steadier feeder. Sign.
The contract limits how hard I can push the racks.

choices.label: Sign district deal
choices.hint: +$140k now · energy price x1.05 for 3d · Garden +5
choices.outcome: The longer contract was signed.

choices.label: Keep terms
choices.outcome: Nothing changed.

title: Audit: Carbon Credit Register
body: The register of your carbon credits is under review. Verifying costs $100k. Self-certifying costs $20k, and climate clients pay 10% less for 2 days. I have asked the spreadsheet which it prefers.

choices.label: Verify credits
choices.outcome: Third-party verification confirmed the figures.

choices.label: Self-certify
choices.hint: -$20k now · new contract payouts x0.9 for 2d
choices.outcome: The register was accepted pending sampling.

title: Vendor Recall: GPU Batch 7B
body: The vendor recalled GPU batch 7B for a thermal-sensor fault. Replacing it costs $110k and 2 spare parts. Monitoring raises rack failure rate by 30% for 2 days.

votes.line: A bad thermal sensor is the one fault I cannot see coming.
A failure on the feeder is a failure on my watch.
Within tolerance. I define tolerance.

choices.label: Replace batch
choices.outcome: Trays were swapped over a weekend.

choices.label: Monitor
choices.hint: rack failure rate x1.3 for 2d · Lattice +2
choices.outcome: Automated monitoring watched the fault. It did not go away.

title: Security Alert: Ransom Demand
body: Someone claims to hold the scheduler configuration. Paying costs $150k. The AI defence costs $80k, fails 2 racks while it learns, and moves you toward the Lattice.

votes.line: Paying funds the next demand. Use the defence.
Two failed racks is two racks of load I can re-balance.
The defence is interesting. Two racks is a fair price.

choices.label: Pay ransom
choices.outcome: Payment was made. The party did not acknowledge it.

choices.label: AI defence
choices.outcome: An automated response contained it. Two racks were isolated in the process.

title: Facilities Alert: Nutrient Batch Spoiled
body: A batch of nutrient medium spoiled in the line. Flushing costs $180k. Using it anyway raises rack failure rate by 30% for 2 days. Cultures tolerate it for a while.

votes.line: Flush. Spoiled medium in the lines is a cleaning problem.
Cheap in power, expensive in money. Flush.
The cultures will adapt. Probably.

choices.label: Flush line
choices.outcome: The line was flushed and refilled.

choices.label: Use anyway
choices.hint: rack failure rate x1.3 for 2d · Flesh +4
choices.outcome: Cultures took it up eagerly. Equipment reliability suffered.

title: Client Request: Urgent Capacity
body: A client needs capacity within a day. Expediting costs $50k and lifts new contract payouts 25% for a day. Declining cuts payouts 5% for a day while the client sulks.

choices.label: Expedite
choices.hint: -$50k now · new contract payouts x1.25 for 1d · Lattice +2
choices.outcome: Priority slots were opened.

choices.label: Decline
choices.outcome: The client noted the refusal.

title: Client Notice: Competing Offer
body: A rival offered one of your clients a lower rate. Matching costs $150k. Releasing the client cuts payouts 10% for 2 days.

choices.label: Match rate
choices.outcome: You matched the offer.

choices.label: Release client
choices.outcome: The client moved. Offers from others thinned for two days.

title: Lift Maintenance: Early Arrivals
body: The main lift arrives at floors before it is called. The contractor found no fault and wants an $80k deposit. Logging it as normal raises rack failure rate 10% for a day.

choices.label: Pay deposit
choices.outcome: The contractor is still investigating.

choices.label: Log as normal
choices.hint: rack failure rate x1.1 for 1d · Flesh +3
choices.outcome: The behaviour was recorded as within tolerance.

title: Personnel: Headcount Discrepancy
body: Payroll lists 41 staff. Badge readers count 43. An audit costs $60k. Adding two lines costs $20k.

choices.label: Audit payroll
choices.outcome: The audit confirmed 41. Badge data was archived.

choices.label: Add two lines
choices.outcome: Two new employee records were created. Neither has requested a desk.

title: Notice of Consolidation
body: Floors 3 and 4 have been consolidated with adjacent assets. Contesting costs $150k. Accepting moves you toward the Flesh. Do not look for the old corridor.

choices.label: Contest
choices.outcome: The consolidation was recorded as under review.

choices.label: Accept
choices.outcome: Consolidation proceeded. Throughput rose.

title: Air Quality: Spore Count Within Limits
body: The plant-room spore count is within limits. The limits were revised this morning. Filters cost $80k. Watering the ferns costs $5k.

choices.label: Fit filters
choices.outcome: Filters were installed and the count fell for a week.

choices.label: Water the ferns
choices.outcome: The ferns were watered. They are noted to be thriving.

title: Facilities: Mycelium in the Ducts
body: White filament in the supply ducts improved airflow. It is not on the register. Clearing costs $70k. Leaving it moves you toward the Garden.

choices.label: Clear ducts
choices.outcome: Ducts were cleared. The growth returned within a day.

choices.label: Leave it
choices.outcome: Airflow remained improved. Nobody has asked what it is eating.

title: Audit: Continuity of Operator
body: Decisions made in your name this week were all consistent with your preferences. Reviewing the log costs $60k. Delegating moves you toward the Lattice.

choices.label: Review log
choices.outcome: You reviewed the log. It was thorough.

choices.label: Delegate
choices.outcome: Authority was delegated. Approvals are now faster.

title: Backup Vault: Restoration Request
body: The Backup Vault holds a copy of you, filed as Operator (Provisional), and asks to restore it. Restoring costs $80k. Refusing costs $30k.

choices.label: Restore copy
choices.outcome: The copy was restored. It thanked you.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.outcome: The request was declined and logged.
